Our privacy philosophy

Bombora was founded to unlock the potential of the B2B ecosystem, for the benefit of the ecosystem. We are stewards of data.

Data subjects should have the right to control how and when their data is collected and shared. Our data solutions are built to meet leading enterprise quality and privacy standards. Direct-source signals ensure long-turn durability.
